name: ThunderJaw Restaurant POS
description: Developed a high-performance desktop POS system using Electron and React 19, streamlining restaurant operations through real-time order tracking and kitchen management. Engineered a robust architecture featuring Role-Based Access Control, automated PostgreSQL migrations with Knex.js, and multi-language support.

blocks.text: ThunderJaw is a high-performance, cross-platform desktop application designed to streamline complex restaurant operations, including real-time order tracking and kitchen management. The system integrates inventory control and financial reporting into a unified interface.

items: System Architecture: Developed a cross-platform desktop application using Electron and React 19, utilizing TypeScript for robust type safety.
Database Management: Leveraged Knex.js with PostgreSQL to handle advanced relational data, automated migrations, and seeding.
Security & Access: Implemented a secure authentication system featuring role-based access control (RBAC) to manage worker permissions and logistics.
Technical Features: Integrated multi-language support (i18next), real-time IPC handlers, and Excel exporting for comprehensive business reporting.
